aibomSystemNamespace.description: Namespace the aibom-webhook chart was installed into.

platform.description: auto, openshift or kubernetes. auto detects OpenShift by its image.openshift.io API; set it when rendering without a cluster.

enabled.description: Add a PodMonitor scraping vLLM's /metrics on port 8000. Needs the Prometheus Operator CRDs.

scripts.description: Script contents, only for installing from a checkout with --set-file. Leave empty for a packaged chart, which embeds them.

image.description: Image for the test pod; needs python3. Empty means the postprocess image at this chart's appVersion.
